display_long_description:
🔒 **Bad Inmate** is a physics-driven VR prison sandbox where everyday life can turn into chaos at any moment. Explore the block, mess with inmates, provoke guards, and interact with almost anything around you.

🥄 Grab, throw, hide, combine, and use everyday objects in unexpected ways. Turn prison junk into tools, weapons, or part of your next bad idea.

👊 Meet inmates and guards with different personalities. Make friends, start trouble, pick fights, work out, play basketball, or simply see how much chaos you can cause.

😈 **Born to Cause Trouble**

You’re not a model prisoner. Break the rules, annoy the guards, and turn prison life into your playground.

[media]

🧱 **Everything Is Grabbable**

Grab, throw, hide, or weaponize almost anything around you. If you can reach it, you can probably use it.

[media]

🤝 **Meet the Inmates**

Prison is full of personalities. Some will help, some will hate you, and some just want trouble. Who knows who’ll become your best friend?

[media]

**Gameplay features:**

🧱 **Physics sandbox** – grab, throw, hide, and combine objects.

👊 **Inmates & guards** – befriend, prank, fight, or annoy them.

🏀 **Prison activities** – explore, exercise, play, and cause trouble.

😈 **Freedom to experiment** – solve situations your own way.
